errors.NOT_AUTHENTICATED: Your session has ended. Please log in again.
errors.CSRF_CHECK_FAILED: The request was blocked for security reasons. Reload the page and try again.
errors.NOT_FOUND: Not found: it may have been deleted meanwhile.
errors.CURRENCY_LOCKED: The currency cannot change: the account already has transactions.
errors.SETUP_ALREADY_DONE: This installation is already set up: log in.
errors.CONFIRMATION_MISMATCH: The name you typed does not match the account name.
errors.PASSWORD_TOO_SHORT: The password must be at least 12 characters long.
errors.PASSWORD_UNCHANGED: The new password must be different from the current one.
errors.PASSWORD_CHANGED_MEANWHILE: The password was changed meanwhile, perhaps from another device. Log in again.
errors.REQUEST_INVALID: Some data is not valid. Check the fields and try again.
errors.REQUEST_TOO_LARGE: The data sent is too large.
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: The change was refused: the data would not be consistent.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.CONFLICT: The data changed meanwhile. Reload the page and try again.
errors.HTTP_ERROR: The server answered with an error.
errors.NETWORK: The server cannot be reached. Check the connection and try again.
errors.SERVER: The server had a problem. Try again in a moment.
errors.QUANTITY_CONFLICT: The change was refused: a quantity would become negative.
errors.CURRENCY_MISMATCH: A transaction can move only to an account with the same currency.

firstRun.restoreUnavailable: Restoring from a backup will be available in a later version.

createAdmin.usernameHint: 3 to 32 characters: letters, digits, dot, dash, underscore.
createAdmin.languageIntro: The language of the app for the administrator. Each user can change it in Settings.

forcedChange.heading: Change your temporary password
forcedChange.intro: You logged in with a temporary password. Choose a new one to continue.

deleteAccount.text_zero: It has no transactions. This cannot be undone.

deleteAccount.confirm: Type the account name to confirm
